description: Promote a verified installed Lab candidate to the last-known-good recovery baseline and mark the build accepted.
name: lab-accept-current

steps.command:
python3 - <<'PY2'
import hashlib,json,pathlib
b=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/etc/optiplex-lab/build.json').read_text()); s=pathlib.Path('/opt/optiplex-lab/server.py'); h=hashlib.sha256(s.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); assert b.get('recovery_state') in {'CANDIDATE_INSTALLED','AUTO_ROLLED_BACK'}; assert b.get('source_sha256')==h; print(h)
PY2

python3 - <<'PY2'
import datetime,hashlib,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/etc/optiplex-lab/build.json'); b=json.loads(p.read_text()); h=hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('/opt/optiplex-lab/server.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(); b.update({'recovery_state':'ACCEPTED','accepted_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'last_known_good_sha256':h}); t=p.with_suffix('.tmp'); t.write_text(json.dumps(b,indent=2)+'\n'); t.replace(p); print('ACCEPTED',h)
PY2
